meta.addition_rule: the lineage's addition = v6 less the union-only case = the added people + the union's response

original_descendants.source: main_case_2026_10_07/lineage_count.cjs additionsAt, v7's custom-count rebase/item route, then v8 forItems8 with every active item rebuilt
original_descendants.parts_rule: two-factor Shapley values: each original descendant part receives half its measured interaction with the other

zero_limit.method: twice half-tiny minus tiny; v5 refuses a literal zero-added payload

original_descendants.intercept_people_rule: old nonreporting descendants excluded; newly observed reporters and nonreporters, coverage, and adopted mixed-unit boundary construction held

observed_nonreporters.extraction_rule: full-model cost less cost after reversing observed-nonreporter native cell parts and their P/F production arrays; public-capital change included; source_carrier_cost_bn retained as an alias of native_engine_cost_bn

reporting_union_at_case_responses.rule: zero-original-descendant limit less observed-nonreporter native full-engine cost and their measured incremental crossing credits; coverage and adopted item11 terms held; case responses, not a freshly calibrated completed-union removal

mixed_unit_removal.replacement_rule: M1/M3 subtract union item5b once; retain existing unlocated crossing-credit projection; add corrected D only on residual unlocated G3 people; do not add old D

D_scaling.replicate_rule: apply the full-sample count ratio to each signed source replicate; option-specific roster count replicates are not regenerated

mixed_unit_removal.caveat: Source rows are v7 deltas, including the one item-5b subtraction and all selected latent health/SNAP interactions. Preserve v7 child_credits. All source policy/calibration assumptions held.

production.scope: generation-end P/F ratio on that generation's existing earnings-key price pieces

decomposition.sign_convention: capital, fiscal lines and unclassified are net costs; P and F are signed welfare/receipt gains; total = capital + fiscal lines + unclassified - P - F
decomposition.borrowing_rule: capital return and private P are not borrowing; unclassified residual/calibration/post-engine amounts require the consumer's declared financing rule

low.adult_minor_uncertainty_rule: conditional CPS price/weight replication; missing-count assumptions are construction sensitivities, not observed counts or an estimated missing-count SE
